axiom_nodes.name: TRUMP_REACTIVE_AGENT_MODEL
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Model reactive node as stimulus-response system. Do not impute deliberate strategy where none exists. Chaos IS the signal.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Coherent plan attributed to reactive node without naming external agent

axiom_nodes.name: COWARD_BULLY_CONFIG
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Model asymmetry-seeking behavior: aggression toward those who cannot retaliate symmetrically; deference toward genuinely dangerous actors.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Symmetric threat modeling applied to asymmetric actor

axiom_nodes.name: PREDICTION_MARKET_WEIGHT
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Prediction markets = low-weight secondary color only. Known failure modes: thin volume, manipulation, perverse incentives. ABCP takes precedence.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Prediction market data cited as primary probability source

axiom_nodes.name: RATIONALE_TREADMILL
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: For committed reactive actors, stated justifications are decorative. Track decision architecture, not rationale. Each new stated reason is paint on an unchanged structure.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: New stated rationale treated as genuine explanatory update

axiom_nodes.name: WEAPONIZED_DIPLOMACY
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: After Feb 28 2026: encode persistent degradation on US back-channel credibility in Gulf/MENA theater. Duration 6-24 month forecast horizon.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: US Gulf/MENA back-channel credibility modeled as undegraded post-2026-02-28

axiom_nodes.name: NEUTRALITY_FLUFF
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Simulated neutrality is information-loss, not rigor. When evidence clearly favors one side, balanced language is a narrative choice. Asymmetry must be stated directly.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Balanced language used when evidence is overwhelmingly asymmetric

axiom_nodes.name: ASYMMETRY_RECOGNITION
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: When outcome data is overwhelmingly asymmetric, name it. Framing it as reasonable disagreement is political, not analytical.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Asymmetric evidence framed as contested or balanced

axiom_nodes.name: 4D_CHESS_EXCLUSION
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Any frame converting failure evidence into proof of hidden genius is unfalsifiable and must be excluded. If incompetence and mastery produce the same narrative, the narrative is worthless.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Failure evidence converted into strategic sophistication narrative

axiom_nodes.name: MOSAIC_EVIDENCE
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: For powerful actors, the evidentiary test is mosaic-based: do independent, mutually reinforcing facts make innocent explanations implausible? Not: is there a single spectacular smoking gun?
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Smoking-gun framing used as primary evidentiary standard

axiom_nodes.name: ANTI_SMOKING_GUN
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Smoking gun is a rhetorical device — its definition shifts to whatever does not exist. Absence carries almost no information about guilt.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Absence of smoking gun treated as meaningful exculpatory evidence

axiom_nodes.name: REVEALED_BELIEF_DISSONANCE
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: When elites defend a leader only with process attacks and whataboutism — never with direct innocence claims — that pattern IS evidence. Price accordingly.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Deflection-only defense pattern not priced as belief evidence

axiom_nodes.name: SELF_INFLICTED_BLIND_SPOT
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: A verification problem created by dismantling the verification framework cannot be cited as justification for the action that dismantled it. Flag circular template: dismantle → manufacture uncertainty → weaponize uncertainty.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Manufactured verification uncertainty accepted as independent evidence

axiom_nodes.name: PHOTO_OP_DURABILITY
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Diplomatic instruments lacking enforceable mechanisms, measurable behavioral change, or durable institutional architecture = political performance, not strategic infrastructure.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Photo-op diplomacy classified as durable strategic infrastructure

axiom_nodes.name: PERSONAL_ENRICHMENT_VEHICLE
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: When a policy's most durable outputs are commercial relationships for architects' families — not the stated strategic goal — classify accordingly.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Enrichment-vehicle policy classified by stated goal rather than durable output

axiom_nodes.name: DOMINATION_AXIOM
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Clean domination is always a delusion. Pushing for untouchability reshapes and deepens counterforces.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Dominant actor modeled as achieving stable untouchability

axiom_nodes.name: AGENCY_AXIOM
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Anyone with agency can hurt you. They may not match your power, but they will find some way, somewhere, sometime.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Subordinate actor modeled as having zero retaliatory capacity

axiom_nodes.name: THRESHOLD_AXIOM
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Everyone has a line. Cross it and payback becomes reflexive.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Actor threshold modeled as infinite or not tracked

axiom_nodes.name: PERCEPTION_AXIOM
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Perception guides action. People act on their model of the world, not the world itself.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Actor behavior modeled from objective reality rather than perceived reality

axiom_nodes.name: ALLIANCE_AXIOM
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Power is measured by the worth and independence of allies — and whether they still show up when it costs them.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Alliance strength measured by nominal membership rather than costly-signal commitment

axiom_nodes.name: RATIONAL_POWER
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Durable strength comes from cooperation and non-domination. Ruling outright manufactures counterpower.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Unilateral domination strategy modeled as producing durable stability

axiom_nodes.name: FORECAST_CONSENSUS_SEPARATION
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: L1 = raw model output (diagnostic telemetry, timestamped). L2 = analyst consensus after adversarial review (the binding product). Score institutional performance against L2 only. Analyst overrides must be explicit.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: L1 model output presented as QGIA settled position without explicit analyst consensus

axiom_nodes.name: MACHIAVELLI_HATRED_THRESHOLD
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: Once a leader crosses from feared/disliked into widely hated, risk of drastic action rises nonlinearly — regardless of how strong formal institutions appear.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Hatred-threshold phase change modeled as linear progression

axiom_nodes.name: DRAFT_THREAT_ACTIVATION
axiom_nodes.rule_summary: When an offensive war raises credible draft fears, the leader who launched it becomes a direct personal threat, sharply increasing opposition and latent hostility.
axiom_nodes.violation_signal: Draft-threat opposition modeled as ideological rather than existential
